title: OPUS: A Simple yet Effective Unified Framework for Open-Vocabulary Detection

problem.summary: promptable architectures, OVD has evolved from text-prompted detection toward unified prompting, where detectors also accept visual prompts such as reference images, boxes, or points.
statements: promptable architectures, OVD has evolved from text-prompted detection toward unified prompting, where detectors also accept visual prompts such as reference images, boxes, or points.
Compared with text prompts, visual prompts provide complementary appearance-level cues and enable finer control in long-tailed or textually ambiguous scenarios.
However, this flexibility has often been achieved through increasingly complex system designs.

limitations.summary: As Text prompting recovers long-tailed semantic coverage, Visual-G increasingly relies on textual semantics in the mixed setting, exposing the limitation of noisy cross-image category prototypes.
items: As Text prompting recovers long-tailed semantic coverage, Visual-G increasingly relies on textual semantics in the mixed setting, exposing the limitation of noisy cross-image category prototypes.
This suggests that the issue is not only the distribution mismatch of Visual-G prototypes, but also the limited granularity of class-level prompt alignment.
However, the source of this complementarity changes over time: ∆T decreases from 8.7 to 2.2, while ∆G increases from 1.6 to 6.6.
